titre: La reprise des exportations horlogères suisses
sous_titre: Variation sur un an des exportations horlogères suisses, en %, mai à août 2026

Mai 2026.texte: Shipments of timepieces rose 0.4% to CHF 2.11 billion ($2.63 billion) for the month

Juin 2026.texte: Swiss watch exports were up 11.2% overall in June, continuing 2026's positive momentum

Juillet 2026.texte: Overall, Swiss watch exports rose 9.6% year over year to 2.63 billion Swiss francs in July.

Août 2026.texte: August saw growth in Swiss watch exports of 9.1%, taking the twelve-month moving average into positive territory
